note: Official Juniper sitemap-index discovery of Mist/Apstra Security Bulletin articles. Only the stable sitemap index URL is pinned; topic-article child sitemap filenames (e.g. sitemap-topicarticle-1.xml) are dynamically discovered and host/scheme/path validated every run by parse_juniper_security_sitemap_index, never pinned directly, since Juniper silently 404ed a previously hardcoded weekly child sitemap. Content grows over time; child sitemap XML is fail-closed parsed.
